verdict.rationale: Resend documents an extensive API/CLI/SDK surface (send, batch, domains, webhooks, API keys, broadcasts, contacts/segments, suppressions, scheduling, inbound email) plus an OpenAPI spec and CLI/MCP server, showing most dashboard actions have programmatic equivalents. However, some dashboard-only features (team SSO/identity-provider sign-in, activity visualization, Vercel-integration auto-provisioning) are not shown as API-exposed. Missing for 10: API parity evidence for team/SSO management, and for the account activity/analytics visualization dashboard feature.
